name: Sichuan Furong Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Sichuan Furong Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of aluminum structural parts for consumer electronics products. Its products are used as shells, back panels, middle frame components of consumer electronic products, such as tablets, laptops and smart phones, middle frame components, as well as the battery tray components of new energy vehicles. The company also engages in the processing, manufacturing, and casting of non-ferrous metals and alloys; manufacturing and sale of mold; processing of spare parts, and mechanical parts and components; recycling, processing, sale of renewable resources; recycling of productive scrap metals; housing rental; …
